clue.text: Man's house may be entered by them

definitions.text: Man's house may be entered by them

parts.words: Man's house may be entered by them
parts.note: reads like door openers for a man's home, but the Isle of Man's parliament has a lower chamber whose members one could be said to enter

explanation.surface: A homeowner's means of letting himself in through the front door.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man, a self-governing island between Britain and Ireland, has a parliament whose lower chamber is the House of Keys; ordinary keys also let you into a house.
explanation.definitionFit: Door locks open with these, and the Manx lower chamber is named the House of them.

clue.text: National emblem trodden underfoot

definitions.meaning: a country's banner flown on a pole
a flat paving stone walked upon

explanation.definitionFit: A banner represents a nation, and a flagstone is a paving slab people walk over.

clue.text: Dismantle party supporting world council

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that supports sits beneath, so the party word goes below the council

parts.note: UN is the United Nations, a council of the world's nations
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: Breaking up a celebration held to back a global assembly.
explanation.definitionFit: To take apart or unfasten something is to reverse its assembly.

clue.text: Composer who uses colour with hesitation

parts.note: to stain is to colour or dye
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.walkthrough: Sir John Stainer was a Victorian English composer of church music, best known for The Crucifixion.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir John Stainer wrote church music such as The Crucifixion, so he is an example of a composer.

clue.text: Firm worked with a cartel apparently

definitions.text: Firm worked with a cartel apparently

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
operated means worked or ran

explanation.surface: A business that collaborated with a price-fixing ring.
explanation.walkthrough: A company (CO) that OPERATED alongside a cartel is literally one that collaborated; the whole clue both builds and defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of a cartel act together to fix prices, so a firm in one has collaborated.

clue.text: He gave Napoleon the boot

parts.note: giving someone the boot is dismissing them; the victor of Waterloo also gave his title to a rubber boot

explanation.surface: The man who kicked the French emperor out.
explanation.walkthrough: The Duke who beat Napoleon at Waterloo in 1815 lends his name to the rubber boot, called a welly in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The Duke who defeated Napoleon at Waterloo also named a style of waterproof boot.

clue.text: The object in view is to get a close shave

definitions.meaning: read literally, an item that is close at hand
a narrow escape

explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape is one that came within inches, and an item close by is literally a nearby object.

clue.text: Very brief time on satellite

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a very brief time

explanation.surface: A moment spent aboard an orbiting body.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth's natural satellite is the body that orbits it.

clue.text: Definitions quiz administered by the DHSS?

definitions.text: Definitions quiz administered by the DHSS?

parts.note: a word's meanings, playfully what it means
a test is a quiz

explanation.surface: A vocabulary quiz set by a government department.
explanation.walkthrough: The DHSS was Britain's former Department of Health and Social Security, which assessed claimants' income in an inquiry into their resources before paying benefits.
explanation.definitionFit: British welfare officials checked a claimant's income and savings before awarding benefits.

clue.text: I ring a son involved with a foreign girl

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled together and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man gives a ring to a young woman abroad, after involving his son.
explanation.definitionFit: Italians address a young unmarried woman by this title, so she is a girl from abroad.

clue.text: Head teachers' organisation

definitions.meaning: informal slang for one's head
the National Union of Teachers, a British trade union

explanation.definitionFit: Slang uses the word for the head, and Britain's former National Union of Teachers had these initials.

clue.text: A shortage of parliamentarians for current measures

parts.note: MPs are Members of Parliament

explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' is electric current here, not 'present'; units of electric current measure its flow.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical current is measured in units named after the physicist Ampere.

clue.text: Organise a free-range poultry enclosure

definitions.meaning: to manage or direct
a fenced area where hens roam

explanation.definitionFit: To manage something is to operate it, and a chicken pen is a fenced area hens roam in.

clue.text: Pernicious, importunate fellow to whom I gave a loan

parts.note: a pest is a nuisance who keeps pestering
lent means gave on loan

explanation.surface: Describing a nagging man who borrowed money from the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Something harmful and destructive is likened to a deadly plague.

clue.text: Fenced in a parking post five feet long

parts.note: pent means penned or shut in
a parking meter stands on a post by the kerb

explanation.surface: A car park enclosure with a lengthy pole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feet' are the metrical units of verse, not measures of length: a line of five of them.
explanation.definitionFit: In poetry a line of five metrical units, as in Shakespeare's iambic verse.

clue.text: One leaving army life for a plumbing job

indicators.note: leaving means the one letter goes out of the longer word

parts.note: soldiering is life in the army
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A soldier quits the army to become a plumber.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumbers join pipes by melting metal alloy into the seams.

clue.text: Where military authority is vested, by and large

definitions.meaning: within a senior army commander
generally, on the whole

explanation.definitionFit: Command rests in a high-ranking officer, and the phrase also means mostly or usually.

clue.text: Kind order

definitions.meaning: a type or variety
to arrange or classify

explanation.definitionFit: A type is a variety, and to arrange things is to classify them.

clue.text: A mathematical function used in any parallel case

indicators.note: used in signals the pieces placed within the other word

parts.note: log is short for logarithm, a mathematical function

explanation.surface: A maths function applied to any similar example.
explanation.definitionFit: A comparison drawing likeness between two situations is a parallel.

clue.text: A bitter brew that goes to Father's head

indicators.note: a brew is a mixture, so the letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A bitter beer that goes straight to Dad's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Father' is a priest, not Dad; the square cap worn by Catholic clergy sits on his head.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catholic priest's square cap is headwear, sitting on the cleric's crown.

clue.text: Somewhat late in the day for levelling the score

definitions.meaning: the later part of the day
making the score equal

explanation.definitionFit: The later hours of the day bear this name, and equalising a score is making it level.

clue.text: To outlaw English would cause sore distress

parts.note: to ban is to outlaw

explanation.surface: Banning English would cause great anguish.
explanation.definitionFit: A curse or cause of misery is something that brings ruin.

clue.text: Incorrect data given for set course

indicators.note: incorrect data are wrongly arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wrong figures supplied for a planned route.
explanation.definitionFit: Steering a ship along a plotted route is setting its course.

clue.text: Part of the Circle Line

parts.note: suggests a stretch of the London Underground route, but means a section of a circle's curved edge

explanation.surface: A section of London's Tube loop.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle line is a London Underground route; here it is just the curved line of a geometric circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved segment of a circle's circumference.

clue.text: The French way to show regret

definitions.meaning: French for street, a thoroughfare
to feel sorry about

explanation.definitionFit: The French word for street names a thoroughfare, and to repent is to lament.

clue.text: Tribe trained in the simple virtues of Judaism

indicators.note: the tribe is inside the words, so in signals letters lying within the phrase

explanation.surface: A tribe schooled in the plain moral values of Judaism.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'simple virtues'. 'Of Judaism' completes the surface and confirms one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the twelve tribes of Israel, the priestly one descended from Jacob's son.

clue.text: Entrances designed for making a come-back

indicators.note: designed means laid out anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: Something reborn is reviving or coming back to life.

clue.text: Where to get a bargain in Manchester

definitions.meaning: a time of reduced prices in shops
a town in Greater Manchester, in north-west England

explanation.definitionFit: Shops cut prices at such an event, and it is also a town in Greater Manchester.

clue.text: Christian Scientist movement currently strong

definitions.meaning: Mary Baker, founder of Christian Science
a swirl of water within a current

explanation.definitionFit: Mary Baker founded Christian Science, and a whirlpool in a stream is a swirling motion.

clue.text: So what puts an end to aggression?

annotationWithheld.why: So what puts an end to aggression? (4): 'So' defines it, but no parse gives the rest; the only N is the last letter of aggression and nothing supplies THE
annotationWithheld.clue: So what puts an end to aggression?

clue.text: Chinese statesman worth $10.000

definitions.meaning: ... Hsiao-ping, older spelling of Deng Xiaoping
read as ..., with G slang for a grand, a thousand dollars

explanation.walkthrough: Teng Hsiao-ping is the older spelling of Deng Xiaoping, China's leader after Mao; split in two, the name reads as ten grand.
explanation.definitionFit: The older romanisation of the post-Mao Chinese leader also reads as ten thousand dollars.

clue.text: Down-to earth women, but accommodating ones

definitions.meaning: read literally, ladies of the soil
women who provide lodgings

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the word means women of the soil, and such women run boarding houses.
